items.title: Steve "Ted" Brown Interview, 1958-04-22
items.q: we gave that job to Don Polo, and he took his place on that particular record.

ctx.x: Mm-hm. Mm-hm. Oh no. On this particular record, at the time we were supposed to record, Don Murray took sick. He had a step to cock or throat. And while he was in the hotel room, Don Murray wrote out all the parts he played, clarinet parts. And we gave that job to Don Polo, and he took his place on that particular record. And he played just like Don Murray. A lot of musicians think it was still Don Murray. You hear that slapping? That's different from the way a lot of them play. Good drama, I'll break that.…
I used to think that was good. Still good. Huh? Still good. Still good. Huh? Still good.
